description: Windows PC cleaner for temporary files, caches, large files, duplicates, and startup entries.
notes: UNDER REVIEW: upstream package.json declares the package license as UNLICENSED, and the repository has no LICENSE file. This conflicts with the README's open-source wording. Do not move this manifest to bucket/ until the upstream licensing is clarified.
The selected Cleanly-portable.exe is electron-builder's configured Windows portable target; Cleanly-setup.exe is the separate NSIS installer.
The upstream safety model permanently deletes caches, temporary files, and logs. Review the selected cleanup categories carefully before running cleanup.
